name: Qualys (QLYS)
teaser: The business is excellent at turning sales into cash, and the price already pays for it. At $172.51 Qualys trades 16% above my Base value of $148.70, and the Base earns about 6.9% a year over five years. New money waits for $104.09 or less; existing holders can stay, with a review above $182.67.
llms: Qualys is a cloud security and compliance software company that guides a free cash flow margin in the low 40s and holds about $808 million of net cash. At $172.51 the stock trades at 23.1 times owner free cash flow, which is free cash flow after stock compensation and a tax adjustment. Bear $113.30, Base $148.70, Bull $182.67. Verdict: Hold at $172.51, maximum buy price $104.09.
